title: The 8 Levels of 'We Need to Talk'
house: Fruit City, a bustling metropolis where produce people live in high-rise apartments, commute via subway, and run chaotic corner stores, all while carrying glowing digital badges on their forehead displaying their current stress or panic levels.
catchphrase: The numbers never lie, but they always hurt.
links: The barista in Level 2 mentioned a calm man in a suit who always leaves massive tips at the downtown cafe.
The glowing digital billboard from Level 5 flickers across the skyline of every episode.
A dropped golden coin near the subway turnstile connects the daily commutes of Level 1 and Level 7.

levels.open_loop: What was written on the blue sticky note left on the kitchen counter?

gegenspieler.tat: Laughs loudly at her low panic rating and blocks her path to the office exit.

levels.name: Mia, 22, Intern
levels.story: 2 Euro Stundenlohn und eine Mitternachts-SMS von meinem Boss – wer das liest, ist sofort ruiniert. The 8 levels of panic when someone says 'We need to talk'. Level 1. Level 1: 98 percent panic because my boss just texted 'We need to talk' at midnight while I am drowning in debt. I am staring at my phone screen in my tiny studio apartment, dropping my keys on the linoleum floor with shaking hands. You are fired before you even start, he spits with cold satisfaction. I want to scream that I worked eighty hours this week for free coffee and broken promises while he sleeps in luxury. Read the note on your keyboard, Mia, before I throw your cardboard box into the rain. Then he said this one sentence that changed everything and destroyed my remaining hope. Das siehst du in Level 1. You'll see that in Level 2.

levels.name: Citrina, 29, Barista
levels.story: The 8 levels of panic when someone says 'We need to talk'. Level 2. Level 2: 75 percent panic when the landlord walks into my cafe and says we need to talk about the lease while customers watch in shock. Sie schüttet absichtlich Milch über die Bar und lacht mich aus, weil ich mir die Miete nicht mehr leisten kann. I am wiping down the sticky espresso machine while steam hisses into the cold morning air and my bank account hits rock bottom. You are doubling the rent starting next month, she announces with pure malice in her eyes. My yellow peel tightens with bitter rage because I built this cafe from scratch with my bare hands and endless sweat. Read what is inside the envelope before you cry, barista, and watch your business die. Then she whispered the one phrase that broke my spirit entirely. Das siehst du in Level 2. You'll see that in Level 3.

levels.name: Avocado, 34, Architect
levels.story: The 8 levels of panic when someone says 'We need to talk'. Level 3. Level 3: 60 percent panic because my business partner texted 'We need to talk' right before the biggest presentation of my career. I am sitting in an upscale downtown steakhouse, nervously poking my fork at a plate of expensive grilled asparagus while my hands tremble uncontrollably. Your blueprint designs are completely rejected by the city council and everyone knows you failed. My soft green flesh sweats under the warm restaurant lights because my entire mortgage and livelihood depend on this single contract. Take your USB drive and pack your desk by five o'clock before I ruin your professional reputation forever. Then er reichte mir den USB-Stick, und plötzlich flackerte das Video kurz vor der Enthüllung ab. Das siehst du in Level 3. You'll see that in Level 4.

levels.name: Oranja, 41, Head Nurse
levels.story: The 8 levels of panic when someone says 'We need to talk'. Level 4. Level 4: 50 percent panic because the hospital director cornered me in the surgical ward to say we need to talk in front of everyone. Sie lacht mich im Flur aus und nennt mich unfähig, während meine Station brennt und Patienten nach Hilfe rufen. I am clutching a stack of patient charts while fluorescent lights buzz overhead with an annoying metallic sound that drives me insane. Your department budget is getting slashed by forty percent starting tonight because you cannot manage your staff. My vibrant orange skin pulses with sudden anger because my nurses are already working double shifts without proper rest or food. Find the cuts yourself or I will make them for you, nurse, and watch your career end in disgrace. Then er sprach diese eine vernichtende Drohung aus. Das siehst du in Level 4. You'll see that in Level 5.

levels.name: Tomata, 36, Bank Teller
levels.story: The 8 levels of panic when someone says 'We need to talk'. Level 5. Level 5: 40 percent panic because the branch manager whispered 'We need to talk' across the bulletproof glass while security guards aimed their tasers. Vierzigtausend Dollar im Minus, und der Manager beschuldigt mich eiskalt des Diebstahls vor versammelter Kundschaft. I am counting stacks of crisp hundred-dollar bills while air conditioning hums quietly in the marble lobby and my palms sweat profusely. Your latest cash transfer was flagged by federal auditors and your accounts are permanently frozen. My ripe red skin feels hot and swollen under the heavy vault lights because I followed every single protocol without a single error. Empty your cash drawer immediately for a full security sweep or face federal prison. Then er grinste und sagte diesen einen grausamen Satz. Das siehst du in Level 5. You'll see that in Level 6.

levels.name: Coco, 52, Landlord
levels.story: The 8 levels of panic when someone says 'We need to talk'. Level 7. Level 7: 15 percent panic because my head accountant whispered 'We need to talk' in my private penthouse office while federal agents surrounded the building. I am pouring a glass of aged bourbon while looking out at my entire city empire through floor-to-ceiling glass windows that suddenly feel like a cage. Your real estate conglomerate is facing federal fraud charges and all properties are being seized immediately without compensation. My hard brown coconut shell feels unbreakable, but my massive empire is built on borrowed time and illegal offshore accounts. Your offshore accounts have just been frozen by the treasury and you are facing twenty years in federal prison. Then he delivered the final verdict that shattered my arrogant world completely. Das siehst du in Level 7. You'll see that in Level 8.

levels.name: Dr. Dragon, 55, Judge
levels.story: The 8 levels of panic when someone says 'We need to talk'. Level 8. Level 8: Zero percent panic because I am the judge who finally demütigt all arrogant characters in a deeply satisfying final twist. Der Richter demütigt alle Arroganten in einem finalen Twist, nimmt ihnen ihr gesamtes Vermögen und verteilt es an die Opfer. I am sitting behind a massive mahogany bench in the Supreme Court of Fruit City while the entire room of corrupt elites holds its breath in absolute terror. Please deliver your final verdict, Your Honor, and make them pay for every single tear they caused. You all thought your secrets were safe behind your glowing badges, but the numbers never lie and justice has arrived for everyone. The numbers never lie to anyone in this city, and now your punishment begins. Das siehst du in Level 8.
